title: Ignition Cut
user_description: Adds a configurable ignition-cut rev limiter to MS41.0 at the ECU's six-cylinder coil final-stage charge commands. Vehicle testing is still required.
description: MS41.0 port of Ignition Cut V7. Both recurring `andb P1L,RL1` coil-charge transactions at file 0x366F8 and 0x3675C call a shared cave at file 0x36820. CUTSW/CUTRPM use the dedicated blank calibration tail at SA 0x3010/0x3011; MS41.0 actual RPM is read from 0xFAE6. Launch Control V4 may independently request spark cut through fd5a.7. The stock path replays the exact displaced ANDB and the cut path suppresses only that scheduled final-stage charge transaction.
